findings.summary: Both findings from the previous final review (rf-79658b81) are fully resolved. (1) The interrupted-claim guard in DdControlPlane.gate now uses _resume_launched (control_plane.py:1261), which checks mode=="resume", instead of _generation_launched which matched any launch entry; this makes the guard reachable when an O_EXCL claim exists without a resume launch entry, so a SIGKILL-in-the-claim-window replay completes the recovery instead of returning already_resumed. The _suspended test fixture now writes a production-shaped launches.jsonl with mode:"fresh", and test_an_interrupted_claim_without_launch_is_completed exercises the production path. (2) The systemd unit now passes --lines-config /data/apps/fleet-graph/current/config/ronin-lines.json (the installed roster path), pinned by test_lines_config_points_at_the_installed_roster; _load_line_roster fails soft on a missing/malformed roster, pinned by TestLineRosterFailSoft, preventing a startup crash loop under Restart=on-failure.
